Things a grown man
should have in his life by 30
A doctor and a dentist he actually visits. Regular check-ups catch small problems before they become big ones. Book them once a year.
A simple will and the right paperwork. It sounds boring, but organised documents protect the people you love. Do it once.
A good barber who knows his hair. A regular cut from someone you trust keeps you looking sharp without effort. Same chair, every month.
A small group of friends he can call at 3am. Not hundreds of contacts, just a few people who would really show up. Keep them close.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A daily learning habit is the best thing I've added to my life.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A daily learning habit is the best thing I've added to my life.

slides.texte_overlay: A sport he keeps doing. Football, running, climbing, boxing. Something that keeps him fit and connected to other people.
A savings account that grows every month. Even small amounts. Watching it grow gives calm and confidence. Automate it.
